source_caption:
🎬 Captain America: Civil War (2016)

Captain America: Civil War follows the Avengers as a major disagreement threatens to tear Earth’s mightiest heroes apart. After a series of dangerous missions causes widespread destruction, governments around the world demand greater control over the superhero team. Tony Stark supports the new regulations, believing the Avengers must be held accountable, while Steve Rogers strongly opposes them, fearing political interference could prevent them from protecting innocent people. As tensions rise, Steve’s determination to defend his longtime friend Bucky Barnes creates an even deeper conflict, forcing the Avengers to choose sides. Starring Chris Evans, Robert Downey Jr., Scarlett Johansson, Sebastian Stan, and Chadwick Boseman, the film delivers spectacular superhero battles, emotional confrontations, and unforgettable action while exploring friendship, loyalty, responsibility, betrayal, and the difficult choices that can divide even the strongest teams.

🎭 Genre: Action • Adventure • Sci-Fi • Superhero

⭐ IMDb: 7.8/10

⏱️ Runtime: 2h 27m • PG-13

🎥 Directors: Anthony Russo & Joe Russo

✍️ Writers: Christopher Markus & Stephen McFeely

📚 Based On: Marvel Comics characters, with inspiration from the Civil War comic storyline.

📺 Where to Watch: Disney+ in the United States.

source_details.synopsis: Captain America: Civil War is a 2016 American superhero film based on the Marvel Comics character Captain America. Produced by Marvel Studios and distributed by Walt Disney Studios Motion Pictures, it is the sequel to Captain America: The First Avenger (2011) and Captain America: The Winter Soldier (2014), and the 13th film in the Marvel Cinematic Universe (MCU).
